title: G04: draft Section 2 outline of the argument (refs #60)
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #60 (parent #26)

- Claim: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/60#issuecomment-6848382153, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-15a6`.
- Outputs:
  - `manuscript/existence/argument-outline.tex`, Section 2 (label `ex-outline`). It is not `\input` anywhere; the include is proposed patch P1 for F01.
  - `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/G04/` (README, ledger, findings and proposed patches, validation, hashes).
- Contributors: Claude (Anthropic) for @ADB991. Four Claude subagents produced read-only summaries of C01–C04, C05–C08, C09–C12 and C13–C16. The parent session checked every label and theorem type, read the statement, the assembly, all five `Input` environments and the running constants directly, and wrote the text.

**What it establishes:** an author draft of the outline only. It has seven parts:
- the status of the argument: the target is conditional on `ex-joint-input`, and there is no mass-gap claim;
- the reader prerequisites (G03 P3);
- the context;
- the order of limits;
- a nine-step plan in dependency order, each step pointing to its producing labels;
- a map from steps to sections;
- the open interfaces, taken from `known-open-edges.md` and the C ledgers.

It adds no mathematics and uses no Lean names.

**What remains uncertain:**
- G04-F1: whether the C10 coefficient $\lambda_G=11C_G/(24\pi^2)$ equals $2b_0$ of the running-coefficient unit depends on the Casimir normalization. The identification of the shooting slope $s_G$ is also unchecked. The outline states both as open (C11-to-G02-running).
- Five new citations (Wilson 1974, Gross–Wilczek 1973, Politzer 1973, Osterwalder–Schrader 1973, Bałaban 1987) have metadata checked on INSPIRE only; their texts were not read here. They are listed in findings §H for G03 pass 2, and their entries are proposed in P2.
- The descriptions of most chapters rest on subagent summaries, checked against labels but not line by line (ledger column "Evidence").

## Evidence

- Basis: `codex/existence-monograph` @ `17b8f913d3ec1dd7d38b9b8f9756b889b2c72d1c`; Lean pin `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464` untouched.
- Commands run:
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: "Blueprint structure OK: 4 units".
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
  - A local wrapper (`existence.tex` + the outline after `statement` + the P2 bibitems) built with `latexmk -pdf`: exit 0, 964 pages, no undefined references or citations. The only warning is the pre-existing amsmath `\atopwithdelims`.
  - Rendered pages 23–28 were inspected visually.
  - All `\ref` targets and environment types were checked with grep. Details are in `results/G04/validation.md`.
- Not performed:
  - Lean: no source claims are made.
  - Independent review.
  - Reading the five historical sources: APS and Springer hosts are blocked here.
- Interface changes: none. No existing file is modified.

## Review and handoff

- [x] The scope matches the task and has no duplicate declaration ownership.
- [ ] Source citations and hypotheses have been checked, where applicable. (Historical citations: metadata only; see findings §H.)
- [x] Applicable literature results were sought; substantive steps have detailed proofs or verified references. (The outline proves nothing; it points to the producers.)
- [x] Structural checks pass.
- [x] Draft/reviewed status is accurate; stale reviews were cleared or renewed.
- [x] The issue has a handoff and links to any durable Bots notes.

Required next review: mathematics and source correspondence of the outline (independent of this author). G03 pass 2 should audit the historical claims, and the G05 notation/order contract should be applied before finalization.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
